archetypes.label: Light pistol
archetypes.summary: A small self loading pistol: quick to bring up, short effective range, light damage.

archetypes.label: Revolver
archetypes.summary: A double action revolver: slower cycle than an autopistol, a little more damage per shot.

archetypes.label: Heavy or magnum pistol
archetypes.summary: A large frame pistol with a hard hitting round: slow to settle, heavy in the hand.

archetypes.label: Machine pistol
archetypes.summary: A pistol that fires in bursts: very light rounds, short range, quick cycle.

archetypes.label: Light SMG
archetypes.summary: A compact automatic weapon firing pistol rounds: fast cycle, short range, low damage per shot.

archetypes.label: Heavy SMG
archetypes.summary: A larger submachine gun with a stronger pistol round: more damage per burst, a slower cycle.

archetypes.label: Personal defence weapon
archetypes.summary: A compact weapon with a small armor piercing round: modest damage, better penetration, steady handling.

archetypes.label: Pump shotgun
archetypes.summary: A hard hitting short range weapon with a deliberate cycle.

archetypes.label: Semi automatic shotgun
archetypes.summary: A shotgun that reloads itself: faster follow up shots, a little less punch.

archetypes.label: Automatic shotgun
archetypes.summary: A heavy shotgun firing bursts: very short range, large damage per burst.

archetypes.label: Carbine
archetypes.summary: A short rifle: handy and quick to bring up, a little less damage and reach than a full rifle.

archetypes.label: Assault rifle
archetypes.summary: A balanced automatic rifle: medium damage, good reach, bursts of three.

archetypes.label: Battle rifle
archetypes.summary: A full power self loading rifle: more damage and penetration than an assault rifle, a slower cycle.

archetypes.label: Bolt action hunting rifle
archetypes.summary: A single shot rifle with long reach and strong rounds: slow to aim, accurate far away.

archetypes.label: Designated marksman rifle
archetypes.summary: A self loading rifle tuned for single aimed shots: long reach, long aim time.

archetypes.label: Sniper rifle
archetypes.summary: The longest reach and hardest hit of the single shot rifles, with a long warmup and a slow cooldown.

archetypes.label: Anti materiel rifle
archetypes.summary: A very heavy single shot rifle: huge damage and penetration, long warmup, slow cooldown, heavy to carry.

archetypes.label: Light machine gun
archetypes.summary: A belt or box fed automatic weapon: long bursts, a long warmup, heavy to carry.

archetypes.label: General purpose machine gun
archetypes.summary: A full power machine gun: more damage per round than a light machine gun, heavier, longer reach.

archetypes.label: Heavy machine gun or minigun
archetypes.summary: A rotary or heavy weapon: very long bursts of light damage, a long spin up, very heavy.

archetypes.label: Short bow
archetypes.summary: A simple bow: light arrows, short reach, quick to draw.

archetypes.label: Recurve bow
archetypes.summary: A better bow: more damage and reach than a short bow, a little slower.

archetypes.label: Great bow
archetypes.summary: A war bow: heavy arrows, the longest reach of the bows, a long draw.

archetypes.label: Crossbow
archetypes.summary: A mechanical bow: strong bolts, good penetration, a long cranking cooldown.

archetypes.label: Knife
archetypes.summary: A small blade: quick swings, modest damage, very light.

archetypes.label: Short sword
archetypes.summary: A one handed blade: a stab and a cut of equal power, an even tempo.

archetypes.label: Long sword
archetypes.summary: A two handed or bastard blade: much harder hitting than a short sword, with a slower swing.

archetypes.label: Axe
archetypes.summary: A single edge on a haft: one strong cut, a blunt haft.

archetypes.label: Mace
archetypes.summary: A blunt head on a haft: one heavy blunt attack, a poking haft.

archetypes.label: War hammer
archetypes.summary: A heavy blunt head: the hardest blunt hit of the one handed weapons, a slow swing.

archetypes.label: Spear
archetypes.summary: A thrusting weapon: a strong stab with extra penetration, a slow tempo.

archetypes.label: Polearm
archetypes.summary: A long hafted weapon with a blade or hook: heavy damage and a very slow swing.

archetypes.label: Club
archetypes.summary: A simple blunt weapon: easy to make, a modest blunt hit, a quick tempo.

archetypes.label: Staff
archetypes.summary: A single blunt attack: light and slow.

actions.label: Bolt action
actions.summary: One round per cycle, worked by hand between shots.

actions.label: Lever action
actions.summary: One round per cycle, a little quicker than a bolt.

actions.label: Pump action
actions.summary: One round per cycle, pumped between shots.

actions.label: Semi automatic
actions.summary: One round per trigger pull, no manual cycling.

actions.label: Burst fire
actions.summary: A short burst per trigger pull.

actions.label: Full automatic
actions.summary: A long burst while the trigger is held.

actions.label: Draw and loose
actions.summary: One shot per draw, as bows and crossbows work.

calibres.label: Small
calibres.summary: 9 mm class pistol rounds, light arrows

calibres.label: Large
calibres.summary: full power rifle rounds, magnum pistol rounds

balance.label: Weaker than most of its class
Stronger than most of its class
